# tsParticles 4.5.0

Unmodified browser builds distributed with Arcane Duel so the original fusion
particles work offline and with the production `script-src 'self'` policy.
Previously the game requested the floating `@4` CDN URL. On 2026-10-31 both
packages resolved to 4.5.0; this copy pins that exact version.

- `engine.min.js`: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@tsparticles/engine@4.5.0/tsparticles.engine.min.js
- `slim.min.js`: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@tsparticles/slim@4.5.0/tsparticles.slim.bundle.min.js
- License: MIT, copyright Matteo Bruni. Both packages include the identical
  license reproduced in `LICENSE`.
